molly (Docs): Quick flag: the /v1/chat/completions doc page has an incorrect example — it uses a top-level "result" array with "text" instead of the actual "choices[].message.content" shape, and the Python snippet still calls the old openai.Completion.create. We should patch before tomorrow's push.

sam (SDK): Thanks. Can you paste the broken JSON and the expected canonical response? I can update Python + JS snippets and the example blocks.

molly (Docs): Bad example: ```json{"id":"cmpl-xxx","object":"chat.completion","result":[{"text":"Hi"}]}```Expected: ```json{"id":"cmpl-xxx","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi"}}]}```Also note the Python snippet should use `client.chat.create(...)` and access `response.choices[0].message.content`.

sam (SDK): I'll open a docs PR to fix the response example, update code snippets to client.chat.create, and add a short migration note.

lee (Product): Add a 1-2 line migration blurb mapping old fields (result/text) -> new fields (choices/message/content) and link to /docs/migrations/chat-response-shape. Keep it concise.

molly (Docs): Drafted: "Note: legacy examples used a top-level \"result\" array with \"text\" fields. New chat completions return \"choices[].message.content\"; update your parsing accordingly. See /docs/migrations/chat-response-shape." I'll also include a tiny mapping snippet in the PR.

ana (Eng): Can you include a compact JSON Schema block so our docs linter can validate the example? I can enable a check if it's present.

molly (Docs): Good call, adding a minimal JSON Schema inline.

deploy-bot: docs-build: started (job 5333)

ana (Eng): Ran a quick check against staging — responses match choices[].message.content, no wrapper.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 5333) — preview: https://deploy-preview-1310--docs.redwood.ai/chat/completions

sam (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 — fixes: corrected response example, updated Python/JS snippets to client.chat.create, short migration note, and added JSON Schema. Requesting review from @molly and @lee.

molly (Docs): Reviewing. Small nit: make the Python code comment show `response.choices[0].message.content` explicitly so readers know where to pull the assistant text.

sam (SDK): Updated and pushed commit. CI running.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 5334) — preview: https://deploy-preview-1311--docs.redwood.ai/chat/completions

sam (SDK): CI green. Ready to merge pending your approval @molly.

molly (Docs): Approved and merged. Added a changelog bullet under "Docs updates" for this week. :thumbsup:

sam (SDK): Filed follow-up: infra#771 to add a docs unit test asserting example JSON matches SDK output shape.

molly (Docs): Closing thread. If anything else comes up ping #docs. :sparkles:
